REVISION: 94e4a0991f0da98cbf6fa7103cad3dcebc71a04b

Answers to the five fence questions, each recomputed from raw evidence:

1. Titan receipt (job 1275968, revision a3f2429b) against the H200 receipt at the same revision (job 1274510): 20 of 20 edits match on the converged flag, the termination reason and the trip_count, and 20 of 20 also match on the vertical-centroid qualification. The comparison was recomputed cell by cell from the two receipt JSONs, not read from the published table. The maximum boundary displacement is 0.1513229613096163 m on titan against 0.15132296130961653 m on the H200: maximum absolute difference 3.47e-16 m, with 5 of 20 edits differing at about 1e-15 relative. That is round-off-level agreement, not bit-identity.
2. run() sets constraint_pairs unconditionally at a3f2429b: line 2456 of benchmarks/coil_edit_latency.py is exactly constraint_pairs = (prepared["vertical_centroid_pair"],) and the enclosing run() at line 2410 takes no constraint parameter. git log -S on the line resolves to c920e30d9 as the introducing commit, which is the commit that imposes the vertical current-centre on the coil-edit sweep. The record's configuration caveat is correct: the brief's "no vertical current-centre constraint" is unreachable from the driver's command line at that revision.
3. The banked 10-of-20 receipt at d3849192 (job 1273580) carries no vertical_centroid rows: verified 0 of 20 rows, constraint {} in the case block, converged_edit_count 10.
4. The measurement-host guard on titan: _require_measurement_host() admits an off-host run only when NOVA_COIL_EDIT_OFF_HOST_PROVENANCE is set AND the resolved platform is gpu, returning before any H200 check; the receipt stamps runtime.off_host_marker with the named reason, beside device Tesla P100-PCIE-16GB and node 98dci4-gpu-0002.iter.org. The adjacent node's control at the banked revision shows the unmarked run refusing (RuntimeError: one H200 is required, got cuda:0), so the guard is not inert — with the caveat that the control was recorded at d3849192, not at a3f2429b.
5. Committing docs beyond the report-only fence: the subject's own SCOPE fence explicitly grants docs/evidence/archive/single-grid-solver-cutover-landed.html, docs/figures/single-grid-solver-cutover and docs/plans/single-grid-solver-cutover.html, and commit 94e4a099 touches only paths inside that grant, with nine additions and no deletions, so the commit is within the authority the brief conveyed. The EVIDENCE clause's "nothing is committed" contradicts that grant; the record does not note the conflict. Acceptable as the evidence record: yes.
